title: BADLANDS GRAND OPENING — OCTOBER 16
summary: The gates to Badlands open Friday, October 16 at 8:00 PM Eastern Time! Be there for the launch of our newest DayZ server.
content:
SURVIVORS, THE WAIT IS ALMOST OVER!

Beyond the Outbreak is opening the gates to our brand-new Badlands server on Friday, October 16, 2026, at 8:00 PM Eastern Time (EDT).

A new map. A new beginning. A fresh chance to carve out your place in the wasteland. Whether you are a veteran of Beyond the Outbreak or joining us for the first time, we want to see you there for opening night.

The server is scheduled to go live at 8:00 PM. Keep an eye on our Discord and Badlands server page for connection details and any launch updates.

Survive. Adapt. Overcome.
— Beyond the Outbreak Administration
